title: BAIT Automated Investment Pipeline — API Synchronized
description: Pipeline automatizado de investimentos BTC→ETH→Deploy com API Binance sincronizada, state machine, circuit breaker, e failover.

core_modules.purpose: Configuração centralizada — Binance, Custody, Ethereum, Phases, Retry, Monitoring
core_modules.secrets: Variáveis de ambiente APENAS (BINANCE_API_KEY, BINANCE_API_SECRET, DEPLOYER_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD)

core_modules.purpose: State machine com fases: IDLE → PHASE_1 → PHASE_2 → PHASE_3 → DEPLOYED. Crash recovery via state.json
Cliente Binance API com HMAC-SHA256, circuit breaker, exponential backoff, rate limit handling
Monitor de balances — BTC (Blockstream API) + ETH (JSON-RPC) + Binance
Orquestrador central — sincroniza todo o fluxo: BTC custody → Binance swap → ETH withdraw → Deploy
CLI interface — preflight, balances, phase1, phase2, full, simulate, status, stop

architecture.data_flow: BTC Custody Fund → Binance BTC Deposit → ETHBTC Limit Order → ETH on Binance → ETH Withdraw → Deployer Wallet → Mainnet Deploy

phases.PHASE_1_DEPLOY: Vendendo 0.01 BTC → ~0.525 ETH para gas de deploy
phases.PHASE_2_LIQUIDITY: Vendendo 0.20 BTC → ~12.5 ETH para liquidez Uniswap V3
phases.DEPLOYED: Contratos deployados e operacionais na mainnet

state_machine.crash_recovery: Estado persistido em state.json — retoma automaticamente após crash

custody_fund.blocker: BTC key recovery — 2,146 keys tested, 0 matches. Resolução: recuperar Electrum wallet, corrigir seed, ou usar custody sweep addresses via método alternativo.

phase_2.purpose: Liquidez Uniswap V3 (capital, recuperável via removeLiquidity())

cli_commands.balances: Checar todos os balances (custody + Binance + deployer)
cli_commands.phase1: Executar Phase 1: 0.01 BTC → 0.525 ETH para deploy gas
cli_commands.phase2: Executar Phase 2: 0.20 BTC → 12.5 ETH para liquidez
cli_commands.simulate: Simular pipeline no testnet Binance (sem fundos reais)
cli_commands.status: Status do pipeline e state machine

required.BINANCE_API_KEY: Chave API Binance (LEIA e SPA only)

blockers: BTC key recovery (2,146 keys tested, 0 matches)
